name: The Chapel
summary: The tallest building in town; the bells fall from here into the mist. Holy water, candle-smoke, stone saints. To an ordinary traveler, a place to pray for safe roads; to you, every step past the threshold is like walking on red-hot iron. The inquisitor's men have been circling lately, asking whether anyone has seen "a girl who doesn't age."
affordances: As a merchant, donate and buy a clean name
Listen in on confessions; ask about 'the one on the notice'
Leave quickly — lingering here by day keeps suspicion climbing
danger: Holy water and the unending bells dock your checks; with the inquisitor present, your eyes and your avoidance of the relics are all noted.
